Class Transaction.Builder

java.lang.Object
com.konbini.model.Transaction.Builder
Enclosing class:
Transaction
public static class Transaction.Builder extends Object
Builder class for constructing Transaction objects with flexible configuration. Handles tax calculation, discount application, payment processing, and inventory management.
